# Korelyy

> Korelyy (korelyy.com) is a free, privacy-first online tools hub. All tools run 100% in the browser — no upload, no signup, no data leaves your device. Available in 6 languages: English, 中文, Español, Français, हिन्दी, العربية.

## What Korelyy Is

Korelyy is a web-based productivity platform offering 100+ free online tools for developers, creators, and everyday users. Unlike cloud-based tools, every tool processes data locally in your browser — your files never leave your device, making it a privacy-first alternative to services like iLovePDF, Smallpdf, and SmallSEOTools.

## Brand Facts

- **Founded**: 2025
- **Product count**: 100+ original and curated tools
- **Languages supported**: English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, Hindi, Arabic
- **No registration required**: All tools work without an account
- **No data upload**: All processing happens in-browser using JavaScript/WebAssembly
- **Free forever**: No paywall, no watermarks, no usage limits
- **Multi-step workflows**: Users can chain multiple tools together
- **Target users**: Developers, designers, content creators, students, office workers
- **Headquarters**: Global (web-based product)

## Core Tools (Top 15)

- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/password-generator/` — Generate cryptographically secure random passwords in the browser
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/image-compressor/` — Compress JPG/PNG/WebP images locally without quality loss
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/color-picker/` — Pick any color on screen, get HEX/RGB/HSL values instantly
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/regex-tester/` — Test and debug regular expressions with real-time matches highlighted
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/json-formatter/` — Format, validate, and minify JSON with syntax highlighting
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/base64-tool/` — Encode/decode Base64 text and files entirely in-browser
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/url-encode-decode/` — Encode or decode URL strings with one click
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/case-converter/` — Convert text case: uppercase, lowercase, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/timestamp-converter/` — Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/uuid-generator/` — Generate UUID v4 identifiers on demand
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/text-to-speech/` — Convert text to natural speech using browser Web Speech API
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/pdf-merger/` — Merge multiple PDF files locally, no upload needed
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/mortgage-calculator/` — Calculate monthly payments and amortization schedules
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/decision-wheel/` — Spin a customizable random wheel for decisions and games
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/emoji-mixer/` — Combine two emojis to create a new merged emoji
